what: Collapsed state left by #17272: src/runtime/positions.py current_net_position_qty() still returns 0.0 (flat) when the journal file is missing or unreadable, so 'could not look' reads as 'flat'. #17272 fixed the sibling has_open_trade_for_strategy (now None -> per-tick refusal) but left this one because a tri-state here would also refuse reduce/close dispatches. Fix: return None for could-not-look, and at each caller refuse only NEW-exposure adds that tick (reduce/close/flip proceed on the venue's own position read), with the note_open_trade_read red flag. Tests: missing journal -> add refused that tick, close still dispatched.
